hero_intro: Federal real estate advisory and brokerage services focused on mission-ready facilities, disciplined lease execution, and healthcare environments that serve our nation's veterans and their families.
about_intro: Walker Development & Construction LLC, doing business as Walker DC, is an SBA-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business focused on federal commercial real estate brokerage and advisory services.
about_detail: Founded by a retired U.S. Army aviator and former Department of Veterans Affairs Senior Realty Specialist, Walker DC combines operational discipline with firsthand knowledge of federal leasing, acquisition requirements, and the facilities that support veteran healthcare.
about_commitment: We bring a mission-first approach to every assignment, with integrity, accountability, and attention to the details that determine successful outcomes.
services_heading: Commercial Real Estate & Federal Leasing Services
experience_heading: Experience Supporting the VA Healthcare Mission
experience_intro: Our leadership understands the federal real estate acquisition process from the government perspective. Walker DC's founder previously served the Department of Veterans Affairs in senior leasing and project management roles, including as a FAC P/PM Senior Level, FAC COR Level III and FAC FE/C Level III Certifications.
experience_projects: Leadership experience includes work associated with the Department of Veteran Affairs for a total of 1.44 Million ABOA SF for a Total Contract Value (TCV) of $1.46 Billion. These are examples of prior individual federal service experience.

service_1_description: Support for federal lease planning, market surveys, solicitation strategy, offer evaluation, negotiations, and award documentation.
service_2_description: Real estate solutions for VA outpatient clinics (OPC), community-based outpatient clinics (CBOC), medical centers (VAMC), and specialty healthcare facilities including Residential Rehabilitation Treatment Program (RRTP), Community Living Centers (CLC) and Research & Developments (R&D).
service_3_description: Occupier-focused market intelligence, site selection, lease analysis, negotiations, and acquisition advisory services.
service_4_description: Evaluation of locations within the Delineated Area (DA), access, parking, infrastructure, availability, and suitability for federal and healthcare missions.
service_5_description: Comparative lease economics, cost and price analysis, proposal review, and risk-informed decision support.
service_6_description: Coordination of complex real estate initiatives from initial requirements (SCIP) through lease execution (LE), Lease Delivery (LD) and occupancy planning.
bio_1: Kent Walker brings more than 21 years of combined federal and commercial real estate experience to Walker DC. Before retiring from the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, he served as a Senior Realty Specialist and Project Manager, supporting major medical leasing initiatives nationwide encompassing more than 1.44 million ABOA square feet and an aggregate congressionally authorized contract value exceeding $1.46 billion.
bio_2: During his final eight years with VA's Office of Construction and Facilities Management (CFM), Office of Real Property (ORP), Lease Execution (LE) Division in Washington, DC, Kent worked on micro-hospitals, outpatient clinics, residential rehabilitation treatment programs, and research and development facilities. His work extended from strategic capital investment planning (SCIP) through post-award design, tenant improvements, construction, change orders, lease acceptance, activation, and administration.
bio_3: As a former VA Senior Realty Specialist, Kent brings firsthand understanding of federal procurement, negotiation, cost and price analysis, and best-value real estate solutions that support the care of veterans and their families.
bio_4: A service-disabled veteran, Kent served in both the U.S. Marine Corps and U.S. Army over a 20-year military career. He was an AH-64 Apache instructor pilot, earned Senior Aviator, Airborne and Air Assault wings, and received the Army AH-64 Top Gun Award.
